{{Quote|That fella must have been awful important to merit such a big statue. Wonder who he was?|[[Corso Riggs]], upon viewing Darrus Alde's holostatue|<ref name="Corso Riggs Dialogue">{{TORcite|type=location|Ambient dialogue from Corso Riggs, [[House Alde (estate)|House Alde]]|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>}}
'''Darrus Alde'''<ref name="King's Pass" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Death Mark" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the head of [[House Alde]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after<ref name="King's Pass" /> the planet was colonized by Humans around [[27,500 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> When the other warring noble families gathered for a battle at a [[King's Pass|canyon]] east of the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]], Alde prevented the fighting by parleying with the various houses and convincing them to end their rivalries.<ref name="King's Pass" />

Under Alde's leadership, the building known as the [[Elysium]] was constructed in the [[Glarus Valley]] to house the newly-formed [[Alderaanian Parliament]], and he was elected by the Parliament at the Elysium to serve as the first [[King/Legends|King]] of Alderaan.<ref name="King's Pass" /> The canyon was named after Alde,<ref name="House Alde">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Alde}}</ref> as was the [[King's Road]] that led from the King's Pass to the [[House Alde (estate)|Alde estate]].<ref name="King's Pass" /> His descendants in House Alde later prided themselves on their purity of their lineage,<ref name="House Alde" /> displaying a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the king in their estate and keeping a statue of Darrus in the [[Royal Museum of Alderaan|House Alde Royal Museum]].<ref name="Rancor">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Like a Rancor in a Pottery Shop|Alderaan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Darrus Alde was first mentioned in the Codex entries for King's Pass and House Alde in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]].<ref name="King's Pass" /><ref name="House Alde" /> He is represented in statues and holograms in House Alde's estate.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=location|Fort Alde, The Juran Mountains|Alderaan}}</ref>
